messages.en:
{07 14 00}Gar har har! Don't make me
laugh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! You
got stung by bees?{01 00 00 05 00}
It's not even noon yet{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
You should wash your face
and start your day over.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Gar har har! Ära aja mind
naerma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Sind
nõelasid mesilased?{01 00 00 05 00}
Pole veel lõunagi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Sa peaksid näo pesema
ja päeva otsast alustama.

messages.en:
Those bees did a number
on you this morning,
didn't they, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}You've gotta take better
care of yourself there!
Watch your back!
messages.et:
Need mesilased tegid sulle
täna hommikul tuule alla,
kas pole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}Sa pead enda eest paremini
hoolitsema!
Vaata ette!

messages.en:
{07 18 00}Gross! What's wrong with
your face?!{01 00 00 14 00} Did you get
stung?!
{07 16 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 05 00} You're so clumsy!{01 00 00 0f 00}
I bet you froze up when
you saw 'em{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 02 00}When you see a bee,{01 00 00 0f 00} you
gotta act fast{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 11 00} and run like
mad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 18 00}Jälk! Mis su näoga
on?!{01 00 00 14 00} Kas sind
nõelati?!
{07 16 00}Uhh!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa oled nii kohmakas!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Vean kihla, et sa tardusid,
kui neid nägid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 02 00}Kui näed mesilast,{01 00 00 0f 00} pead
tegutsema kiiresti{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 11 00} ja
nagu hull jooksma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} what's wrong?{01 00 00 14 00}
That face of yours is 
offensive!
{07 0b 00}Didn't I tell you?{01 00 00 14 00} You gotta
watch out for bees,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}I know shakin' trees is fun
and all, but if a beehive
drops out...
...there's only one thing to
do.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 03 00}RUN, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} mis viga?{01 00 00 14 00}
See sinu nägu on
solvav!
{07 0b 00}Kas ma ei öelnud?{01 00 00 14 00} Sa pead
mesilaste eest hoiduma,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Tean, et puude raputamine
on lõbus, aga kui mesitaru
alla kukub...
...on ainult üks asi, mida
teha.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 03 00}JOOKSE, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Yo!{01 00 00 0f 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} What
happened to that{01 00 00 05 00} face of
yours? You look terrible!
{07 0b 00}Ah, stung by bees,{01 00 00 05 00} huh,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}That's just
what I warned you about!
When bees are chasing you,{01 00 00 05 00}
duck into someone's house!
{01 00 00 0a 00}It's not brain surgery!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Jou!{01 00 00 0f 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Mis
juhtus selle{01 00 00 05 00} sinu näoga?
Sa näed kohutav välja!
{07 0b 00}Ah, mesilaste nõelata,{01 00 00 05 00} mis,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Just selle eest
ma sind hoiatasin!
Kui mesilased sind ajavad,{01 00 00 05 00}
põika kellegi majja!
{01 00 00 0a 00}See pole ajukirurgia!
